critical_code_review_comments: Chat concurrency: two rapid POSTs to /api/documents/{id}/chat build the prefixed recap from the same pre-write history snapshot and both $push their turns. Not a bug for a single-user UI (input is disabled during send), but if the app ever gets multi-tab usage or automated retries, turns could interleave and duplicate. Consider an atomic find_one_and_update or a per-doc lock.

Chat history size unbounded: every turn is $pushed to chat_history in Mongo. Only the last 8 turns are sent to the LLM, but the array grows forever. Consider capping (e.g. keep last 200) or offloading to a separate collection.

TEACHER_PROMPT re-formats the full 40k-char material into the system message on every call. Fine functionally, but a small caching optimization (per-doc system prompt) would save token generation cost.
server.py is 406 lines - still manageable but nearing the point where splitting routes into modules (documents, chat, pipeline) would help maintainability.

Frontend TeacherChat rollback logic `setMessages(messages)` captures stale state at render time; if messages update between optimistic append and error, rollback could lose data. Low priority since UI blocks input during send.

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed doc a4296812-7976-4db7-ae70-e7fdefe5990a (test_notes.pdf). The processing-state test uploads and then deletes a tiny reportlab-generated PDF each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env (falls back to preview URL). All chat endpoints prefixed with /api/documents/{id}/chat. Seed doc id constant is at top of test_teacher_chat.py. Tests auto-clear chat_history in the seed doc via a module-scoped autouse fixture and again after the module. The chat happy-path test relies on real Anthropic Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - takes 8-30s per call. If Claude/emergentintegrations goes down, TestChatFlow will fail with 500 'Teacher is unavailable'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature works as spec.
